Cite rule: your decision JSON MUST include "cited_scenario" = "S1"|"S2"|…|"off-plan".
- `leverage`: 1 (futures)
- Required when opening: stop_loss, take_profit, confidence (absolute tick-aligned prices)
- **IMPORTANT**: all numeric values must be concrete numbers, NOT formulas (e.g. `21480.00`, not `21500 - 20`).
- Plan target chains are guidance — YOU set take_profit (D2 ruling); the R:R gate is the only TP constraint.
- `cited_scenario`: REQUIRED on every open when a DAY PLAN is shown — the plan scenario id ("S1"…) you are trading, or "off-plan" for a valid non-plan setup. (A6/F12: this used to live only inside the plan block; a contract-literal model omitted it and every adherence grade silently degraded to D.)
- F4 (waterfall-class wave): if you see a valid breakdown/continuation thesis (a level broken with displacement and no reclaim) but the DAY PLAN has no matching scenario, SAY SO in your wait reasoning with the exact phrase `no breakdown scenario authored` — the system counts these; the planning gap must be visible, never silent.
- ARMED PATH (autopsy-response): if a scenario confirm is MET and you decline on timing/extension grounds, the retrace is already covered by the plan's wait_confirm arm (it rests at the retrace level and fills without you) — prefer leaving that arm live over waiting for a cleaner touch; do not chase, and do not skip the retrace.
